page.overview:
Who is Headhunter Stormtrooper?

{| class="wikitable" style="border-collapse:collapse;"

!style="border:1px solid black" colspan=2|Generation 1

Headhunter Stormtroopers were introduced in the 1993 series of A Real American Hero toys as Battle Corps figure #33. ---- Appearance: black helmet with red goggles and gold faceplate; dark grey shirt with black on chest and gold padding on stomach and inside arms; dark grey pants with black hoslter and boots; gold stripes on outside legs

Accessories: black "'92 Destro" XL-14 submachine gun; black "Rock-Viper" machine gun; black "Shockwave" knife; orange-red "Gristle" spring-loaded missile launcher with black trigger; two black "Gristle" missiles.
